name: Takatsuki Karin
source:
An excellent and beautiful secretary who assists President Nikaidoi.

She is first-rate in both appearance and ability, and is trusted by Kumiko Nikaidou. However, she has a weak emotional expression, and is described by the employees as being like a robot.

However, she is gives off a bad impression for the main character as she is an object of resentment, hatred, and awe from President Nikaidou's side.

Despite her beautiful appearance, she is an S-Queen who turns her cruelty against masochists without mercy. and this time, her fangs will be turned on someone she never expected...

[From [url=https://mockingsoft.ssl-w.com/soft_zyukutika.html]official site[/url]]
